1: // Asteroid Escape game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
5: canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
6: 
7: // Ship definition
8: const ship = {x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height-30, w:20, h:30, speed:4};
9: let keys = {};
10: addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
11: addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
12: 
13: function drawShip(){
14:   ctx.fillStyle='white';
15:   ctx.beginPath();
16:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
17:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x-ship.w/2, ship.y+ship.h);
18:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x+ship.w/2, ship.y+ship.h);
19:   ctx.closePath();
20:   ctx.fill();
21: }
22: 
23: // Asteroids
24: let asteroids=[];
25: let lastSpawn=0;
26: let spawnInterval=1000; // ms
27: let startTime=Date.now();
28: let gameOver=false;
29: 
30: function spawnAsteroid(){
31:   const size = 10+Math.random()*20;
32:   const x = Math.random()*canvas.width;
33:   const y = -size;
34:   const speed = 1+Math.random()*2 + (Date.now()-startTime)/60000; // increase over time
35:   asteroids.push({x,y,r:size,speedY:speed});
36: }
37: 
38: function update(dt){
39:   // ship movement
40:   if(keys.ArrowLeft||keys.a) ship.x-=ship.speed;
41:   if(keys.ArrowRight||keys.d) ship.x+=ship.speed;
42:   ship.x = Math.max(ship.w/2, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w/2, ship.x));
43:   // asteroids
44:   asteroids.forEach(a=>a.y+=a.speedY);
45:   asteroids = asteroids.filter(a=>a.y - a.r < canvas.height);
46:   // spawn
47:   if(Date.now()-lastSpawn>spawnInterval){spawnAsteroid();lastSpawn=Date.now();}
48:   // collision
49:   for(let a of asteroids){
50:     const dx = a.x - ship.x;
51:     const dy = a.y - ship.y;
52:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
53:     if(dist < a.r + ship.w/2){gameOver=true;break;}
54:   }
55: }
56: 
57: function draw(){
58:   ctx.fillStyle='black';
59:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
60:   drawShip();
61:   ctx.fillStyle='gray';
62:   asteroids.forEach(a=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.r,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.fill();});
63:   // score
64:   ctx.fillStyle='white';
65:   ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
66:   const seconds = Math.floor((Date.now()-startTime)/1000);
67:   ctx.fillText('Time: '+seconds+'s',10,20);
68: }
69: 
70: let lastTime=0;
71: function loop(timestamp){
72:   if(gameOver){
73:     ctx.fillStyle='red';
74:     ctx.font='40px sans-serif';
75:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2-100, canvas.height/2);
76:     return;
77:   }
78:   const dt = timestamp-lastTime;
79:   lastTime=timestamp;
80:   update(dt);
81:   draw();
82:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
83: }
84: requestAnimationFrame(loop);

(End of file - total 84 lines)
